mapping_policy: Known published medium elasticity and directional yield anchors are assigned only to the corresponding LAW112 card fields for a parser/constitutive instrumentation fixture. This is a cross-law mapping, not a claim that Haj-Ali proposed or identified LAW112. Unavailable LAW112 fields are explicit defaults or synthetic inactive-fixture values; they are never treated as calibration data.

source_inputs.role: typed source/proxy status for Haj-Ali medium and separate Popil coupon density
transcription notes for Haj-Ali Table 2 elastic properties and limitations
Haj-Ali Tables 1 and 3 directional yield anchors and compression assumptions
explicit source/derived status for Table 3 and out-of-plane assumed values
source identity, condition, dataset class and limits

rho_i.source: Popil 2017, Table 4.1 separate 26# NSSC medium soft-caliper coupon, 679 kg/m^3
rho_i.limitation: Not Haj-Ali's 126 gsm medium sheet and not established as the same sample/roll. Converted 679 kg/m^3 to Mg/mm^3.

E1.source: Haj-Ali 2009 Table 2, 126 gsm NSSC medium MD (paper direction 1)

E2.source: Haj-Ali 2009 Table 2, 126 gsm NSSC medium CD (paper direction 2)

E3.source: Haj-Ali 2009 Table 2; source estimates E33 as E11/250

Itab.source: continuous yield-stress card branch; no fitted tables supplied

nu21.source: Reciprocal orthotropic compliance relation nu21 = nu12*E2/E1 using Table 2 nu12=0.18, E1=4472 MPa, E2=1612 MPa
nu21.limitation: Haj-Ali's reciprocity convention is not fully documented as a solver-ready stiffness matrix; this is an explicitly derived reciprocal choice.

G12.source: Haj-Ali 2009 Table 2; G12 is related to E11 and E22 through the paper's Eq. 1

G23.source: Haj-Ali 2009 Table 2; basis for the out-of-plane shear value is not documented as a direct measurement

G13.source: Haj-Ali 2009 Table 2; basis for the out-of-plane shear value is not documented as a direct measurement

nu1p_nu2p_nu4p_nu5p.source: No matching published LAW112 plastic Poisson set was found; zero values keep this parser fixture explicit and deterministic.
nu1p_nu2p_nu4p_nu5p.limitation: Not measured or calibrated. Plastic Poisson behavior is not qualified.

S01.source: Haj-Ali 2009 Table 1, 126 gsm NSSC medium MD tension yield anchor

S02.source: Haj-Ali 2009 Table 1, 126 gsm NSSC medium CD tension yield anchor

S03.source: LAW112 default; no same-grade positive in-plane shear yield anchor in the source package
S03.limitation: Effectively disables in-plane shear yielding in these small-strain parser fixtures; not a material strength.

S04.source: Haj-Ali 2009 Table 3 for 126 gsm NSSC medium MD; compression value is a source modeling assumption, not a compression measurement

S05.source: Haj-Ali 2009 Table 3 for 126 gsm NSSC medium CD; compression value is a source modeling assumption, not a compression measurement

ASIG.source: Beldie-derived ZD value in the Haj-Ali Table 3 transfer record; not a direct measurement

TAU0.source: LAW112 default; no matching transverse-shear yield value is identified
TAU0.limitation: Effectively disables transverse-shear yielding; not a material strength.

hardening_A_B_C_fields.source: Source package does not identify LAW112 hardening coefficients; Haj-Ali does not tabulate post-yield slopes.
hardening_A_B_C_fields.limitation: Not an identified hardening law. Tension fit endpoints are separate digitized estimates and do not determine the multiaxial LAW112 coefficients.
